import numpy as np
import json

    "trends": [],

    "statistical_tests": [],

for col in ['REPORTDATE', 'ACTSTART', 'ACTFINISH']:
    df[col] = pd.to_datetime(df[col], utc=True, errors='coerce')

df_active = df[~df['row_kind'].isin(

corrective_types = {'cm','em','corrective','corrective maintenance','emergency',
                    'emergency maintenance','emergency repair','breakdown',
                    'breakdown maintenance','breakdown repair','reactive',
                    'reactive maintenance','unplanned','unplanned maintenance',
                    'unplanned breakdown','repair','fault','failure'}
pm_types = {'pm','preventive','preventive maintenance','planned',
            'planned maintenance','pdm','predictive','predictive maintenance',
            'condition based','cbm','inspection','routine','calibration'}
open_statuses = {'inprg','in progress','wappr','waiting on approval','appr',
                 'approved','wmatl','waiting on material','wsched',
                 'waiting to be scheduled','open','hold'}

df_active['_wt_lo'] = df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower()
df_active['_st_lo'] = df_active['STATUS'].str.lower()

df_cm   = df_active[df_active['_wt_lo'].isin(corrective_types) &
                    (df_active['repair_hours'] >= 0)]
df_pm   = df_active[df_active['_wt_lo'].isin(pm_types)]
df_open = df_active[df_active['_st_lo'].isin(open_statuses)]

# ── EDA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try:
    rh = df_active['repair_hours'].dropna()
    rh = rh[rh >= 0]
    result['eda_summary']['repair_hours'] = {
        'mean':   float(rh.mean()),
        'std':    float(rh.std()),
        'min':    float(rh.min()),
        'max':    float(rh.max()),
        'median': float(rh.median()),
        'count':  int(rh.count()),
    }
except Exception:
    pass

# ── SEGMENTATION ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try:
    segs = []

    # repair_hours mean by WORKTYPE
    g = df_active.groupby('WORKTYPE')['repair_hours'].mean().dropna().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE', 'metric_column': 'repair_hours',
                 'aggregation': 'mean', 'label': None,
                 'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in g.items()]})

    # WO count by WORKTYPE
    g = df_active.groupby('WORKTYPE')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE', 'metric_column': 'WONUM',
                 'aggregation': 'count', 'label': None,
                 'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': float(v)} for k, v in g.items()]})

    # WO count by STATUS
    g = df_active.groupby('STATUS')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'STATUS', 'metric_column': 'WONUM',
                 'aggregation': 'count', 'label': None,
                 'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': float(v)} for k, v in g.items()]})

    # repair_hours mean by STATUS
    g = df_active.groupby('STATUS')['repair_hours'].mean().dropna().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'STATUS', 'metric_column': 'repair_hours',
                 'aggregation': 'mean', 'label': None,
                 'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in g.items()]})

    # WO count by FAILURECODE (top 10)
    g = df_active.groupby('FAILURECODE')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'FAILURECODE', 'metric_column': 'WONUM',
                 'aggregation': 'count', 'label': None,
                 'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': float(v)} for k, v in g.items()]})

    # repair_hours mean by FAILURECODE (top 10 by mean hours — MTTR proxy)
    g = df_cm.groupby('FAILURECODE')['repair_hours'].mean().dropna().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'FAILURECODE', 'metric_column': 'repair_hours',
                 'aggregation': 'mean', 'label': 'mttr_by_failurecode',
                 'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in g.items()]})

    # PM share (ratio)
    total_wos = df_active['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_wos    = df_pm['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_share  = pm_wos / total_wos if total_wos > 0 else 0.0
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE', 'metric_column': 'WONUM',
                 'aggregation': 'ratio', 'label': 'pm_share',
                 'results': [{'name': 'pm',     'value': round(float(pm_share), 4)},
                             {'name': 'non_pm', 'value': round(float(1 - pm_share), 4)}]})

    # repair_hours mean by WORKTYPE × STATUS (top 10 by mean hours)
    g2 = (df_active.groupby(['WORKTYPE','STATUS'])['repair_hours']
          .mean().dropna().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10))
    segs.append({'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE|STATUS', 'metric_column': 'repair_hours',
                 'aggregation': 'mean', 'label': None,
                 'results': [{'name': f'{a}|{b}', 'value': round(float(v), 4)}
                             for (a, b), v in g2.items()]})

    result['segments'] = segs
except Exception:
    pass

# ── TRENDS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try:
    df_active['_month'] = df_active['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')

    # MoM WO count (overall)
    mo = df_active.groupby('_month')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_index()
    if len(mo) >= 2:
        last, prev = float(mo.iloc[-1]), float(mo.iloc[-2])
        pct = (last - prev) / prev * 100 if prev else 0.0
        result['trends'].append({'column': 'WONUM', 'period': 'MoM',
                                  'direction': 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat'),
                                  'pct_change': round(pct, 2), 'segment': None})

    # MoM mean repair_hours (overall)
    mo_rh = df_active.groupby('_month')['repair_hours'].mean().sort_index()
    if len(mo_rh) >= 2:
        last, prev = float(mo_rh.iloc[-1]), float(mo_rh.iloc[-2])
        pct = (last - prev) / prev * 100 if prev else 0.0
        result['trends'].append({'column': 'repair_hours', 'period': 'MoM',
                                  'direction': 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat'),
                                  'pct_change': round(pct, 2), 'segment': None})

    # MoM corrective WO count
    df_cm['_month'] = df_cm['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')
    mo_cm = df_cm.groupby('_month')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_index()
    if len(mo_cm) >= 2:
        last, prev = float(mo_cm.iloc[-1]), float(mo_cm.iloc[-2])
        pct = (last - prev) / prev * 100 if prev else 0.0
        result['trends'].append({'column': 'WONUM', 'period': 'MoM',
                                  'direction': 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat'),
                                  'pct_change': round(pct, 2), 'segment': 'CM/EM'})

    # MoM PM WO count
    df_pm['_month'] = df_pm['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')
    mo_pm = df_pm.groupby('_month')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_index()
    if len(mo_pm) >= 2:
        last, prev = float(mo_pm.iloc[-1]), float(mo_pm.iloc[-2])
        pct = (last - prev) / prev * 100 if prev else 0.0
        result['trends'].append({'column': 'WONUM', 'period': 'MoM',
                                  'direction': 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat'),
                                  'pct_change': round(pct, 2), 'segment': 'PM'})
except Exception:
    pass

# ── ANOMALIES ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try:
    anomalies = []
    col = 'repair_hours'
    rh_s = df_active[col].dropna()
    rh_s = rh_s[rh_s >= 0]

    skew = float(rh_s.skew())
    if abs(skew) > 2:
        shift = max(0.0, -float(rh_s.min()))
        tx = np.log1p(rh_s + shift)
    else:
        tx = rh_s.copy()
        shift = 0.0

    q1, q3 = float(tx.quantile(0.25)), float(tx.quantile(0.75))
    iqr = q3 - q1
    lo3, hi3 = q1 - 3*iqr, q3 + 3*iqr
    lo4, hi4 = q1 - 4*iqr, q3 + 4*iqr
    lo5, hi5 = q1 - 5*iqr, q3 + 5*iqr

    extreme_mask = (tx < lo3) | (tx > hi3)
    frac = extreme_mask.sum() / len(tx)

    if frac > 0.05:
        anomalies.append({'column': col, 'row_index': None, 'value': None,
                          'expected_range': f'[{float(np.expm1(lo3)-shift):.2f}, {float(np.expm1(hi3)-shift):.2f}] hrs',
                          'severity': 'low',
                          'explanation': f'{col} is heavy-tailed; flagging suppressed'})
    else:
        if abs(skew) > 2:
            lo_orig = float(np.expm1(lo3) - shift)
            hi_orig = float(np.expm1(hi3) - shift)
        else:
            lo_orig, hi_orig = float(lo3), float(hi3)
        exp_range = f'[{lo_orig:.2f}, {hi_orig:.2f}] hrs'

        for idx in rh_s[extreme_mask].index[:25]:
            val = float(rh_s.loc[idx])
            tv  = float(tx.loc[idx])
            if tv > hi5 or tv < lo5:
                sev = 'critical'
            elif tv > hi4 or tv < lo4:
                sev = 'high'
            else:
                sev = 'medium'
            anomalies.append({'column': col, 'row_index': int(idx), 'value': val,
                               'expected_range': exp_range, 'severity': sev,

try:

try:

        if len(_vc) > 0:
            result['distributions']['FAILURECODE'] = [
                {'label': str(_k), 'count': int(_v)} for _k, _v in _vc.items()
            ]
except Exception:

try:
    if 'REPORTEDBY' in df.columns:

                               'explanation': f'{col} value {val:.2f} hrs lies outside expected range {exp_range}'})

    result['anomalies'] = anomalies[:25]
except Exception:
    pass

# ── ASSUMPTIONS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
result['assumptions'] = [
    "Cancelled work orders (row_kind cancel/void variants) excluded from all KPIs.",

]

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Filter cancelled rows using row_kind
df_active = df[~df['row_kind'].isin(['cancel', 'cancelled', 'canceled', 'void', 'voided', 'rejected'])].copy()

# Parse dates
for col in ['REPORTDATE', 'ACTSTART', 'ACTFINISH']:
    df_active[col] = pd.to_datetime(df_active[col], utc=True, errors='coerce')

# Compute repair_hours if not present (use existing if available)
if 'repair_hours' not in df_active.columns:
    df_active['repair_hours'] = (df_active['ACTFINISH'] - df_active['ACTSTART']).dt.total_seconds() / 3600.0

# Corrective WO filter
corrective_types = ['cm','em','corrective','corrective maintenance','emergency','emergency maintenance',
                    'emergency repair','breakdown','breakdown maintenance','breakdown repair','reactive',
                    'reactive maintenance','unplanned','unplanned maintenance','unplanned breakdown',
                    'repair','fault','failure']
df_corrective = df_active[df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().isin(corrective_types) & (df_active['repair_hours'] >= 0)]

# PM filter
pm_types = ['pm','preventive','preventive maintenance','planned','planned maintenance','pdm','predictive',
            'predictive maintenance','condition based','cbm','inspection','routine','calibration']
df_pm = df_active[df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().isin(pm_types)]

# Open WO filter
open_statuses = ['inprg','in progress','wappr','waiting on approval','appr','approved','wmatl',
                 'waiting on material','wsched','waiting to be scheduled','open','hold']
df_open = df_active[df_active['STATUS'].str.lower().isin(open_statuses)]

# --- EDA ---
try:
    rh = df_active['repair_hours'].dropna()
    rh_valid = rh[rh >= 0]
    result['eda_summary']['repair_hours'] = {
        'mean': float(rh_valid.mean()),
        'std': float(rh_valid.std()),
        'min': float(rh_valid.min()),
        'max': float(rh_valid.max()),
        'median': float(rh_valid.median()),
        'count': int(rh_valid.count())
    }
    total_wos = df_active['WONUM'].nunique()
    corrective_wos = df_corrective['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_wos = df_pm['WONUM'].nunique()
    open_wos = df_open['WONUM'].nunique()
    assets = df_active['ASSETNUM'].nunique()
    pm_share = pm_wos / total_wos if total_wos > 0 else 0.0
    mttr = df_corrective['repair_hours'].sum() / corrective_wos if corrective_wos > 0 else 0.0
    result['eda_summary']['total_work_orders'] = {'mean': float(total_wos), 'std': 0.0, 'min': float(total_wos), 'max': float(total_wos), 'median': float(total_wos), 'count': int(total_wos)}
    result['eda_summary']['corrective_wos'] = {'mean': float(corrective_wos), 'std': 0.0, 'min': float(corrective_wos), 'max': float(corrective_wos), 'median': float(corrective_wos), 'count': int(corrective_wos)}
    result['eda_summary']['pm_wos'] = {'mean': float(pm_wos), 'std': 0.0, 'min': float(pm_wos), 'max': float(pm_wos), 'median': float(pm_wos), 'count': int(pm_wos)}
    result['eda_summary']['open_wos'] = {'mean': float(open_wos), 'std': 0.0, 'min': float(open_wos), 'max': float(open_wos), 'median': float(open_wos), 'count': int(open_wos)}
    result['eda_summary']['assets'] = {'mean': float(assets), 'std': 0.0, 'min': float(assets), 'max': float(assets), 'median': float(assets), 'count': int(assets)}
    result['eda_summary']['mttr_hours'] = {'mean': float(mttr), 'std': 0.0, 'min': float(mttr), 'max': float(mttr), 'median': float(mttr), 'count': int(corrective_wos)}
    result['eda_summary']['pm_share'] = {'mean': float(pm_share), 'std': 0.0, 'min': float(pm_share), 'max': float(pm_share), 'median': float(pm_share), 'count': int(total_wos)}
except Exception:
    pass

# --- SEGMENTATION ---
try:
    seg_results = []
    # repair_hours by WORKTYPE
    wt_grp = df_active.groupby('WORKTYPE')['repair_hours'].mean().dropna().nlargest(10)
    seg_results.append({'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE', 'metric_column': 'repair_hours', 'aggregation': 'mean', 'label': None,
                        'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in wt_grp.items()]})
    # WO count by WORKTYPE
    wt_cnt = df_active.groupby('WORKTYPE')['WONUM'].nunique().nlargest(10)
    seg_results.append({'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE', 'metric_column': 'WONUM', 'aggregation': 'count', 'label': None,
                        'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': float(v)} for k, v in wt_cnt.items()]})
    # WO count by STATUS
    st_cnt = df_active.groupby('STATUS')['WONUM'].nunique().nlargest(10)
    seg_results.append({'segment_column': 'STATUS', 'metric_column': 'WONUM', 'aggregation': 'count', 'label': None,
                        'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': float(v)} for k, v in st_cnt.items()]})
    # repair_hours by STATUS
    st_rh = df_active.groupby('STATUS')['repair_hours'].mean().dropna().nlargest(10)
    seg_results.append({'segment_column': 'STATUS', 'metric_column': 'repair_hours', 'aggregation': 'mean', 'label': None,
                        'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in st_rh.items()]})
    # WO count by FAILURECODE
    fc_cnt = df_active.groupby('FAILURECODE')['WONUM'].nunique().nlargest(10)
    seg_results.append({'segment_column': 'FAILURECODE', 'metric_column': 'WONUM', 'aggregation': 'count', 'label': None,
                        'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': float(v)} for k, v in fc_cnt.items()]})
    # repair_hours by FAILURECODE
    fc_rh = df_active.groupby('FAILURECODE')['repair_hours'].mean().dropna().nlargest(10)
    seg_results.append({'segment_column': 'FAILURECODE', 'metric_column': 'repair_hours', 'aggregation': 'mean', 'label': None,
                        'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in fc_rh.items()]})
    # PM share overall
    pm_share_val = pm_wos / total_wos if total_wos > 0 else 0.0
    seg_results.append({'segment_column': 'WORKTYPE', 'metric_column': 'WONUM', 'aggregation': 'ratio', 'label': 'pm_share',
                        'results': [{'name': 'pm', 'value': round(float(pm_share_val), 4)},
                                    {'name': 'non_pm', 'value': round(float(1 - pm_share_val), 4)}]})
    # MTTR by FAILURECODE (top 10 by mean repair_hours)
    mttr_fc = df_corrective.groupby('FAILURECODE')['repair_hours'].mean().dropna().nlargest(10)
    seg_results.append({'segment_column': 'FAILURECODE', 'metric_column': 'repair_hours', 'aggregation': 'mean', 'label': 'mttr_by_failurecode',
                        'results': [{'name': str(k), 'value': round(float(v), 4)} for k, v in mttr_fc.items()]})
    result['segments'] = seg_results
except Exception:
    pass

# --- TRENDS ---
try:
    df_active['report_month'] = df_active['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')
    monthly_wo = df_active.groupby('report_month')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_index()
    if len(monthly_wo) >= 2:
        periods = monthly_wo.index.astype(str).tolist()
        vals = monthly_wo.values.tolist()
        last = vals[-1]; prev = vals[-2]
        pct = ((last - prev) / prev * 100) if prev != 0 else 0.0
        direction = 'up' if pct > 1 else ('down' if pct < -1 else 'flat')
        result['trends'].append({'column': 'WONUM', 'period': 'MoM', 'direction': direction,
                                  'pct_change': round(float(pct), 2), 'segment': None})
    # Monthly avg repair_hours trend
    monthly_rh = df_active.groupby('report_month')['repair_hours'].mean().sort_index()
    if len(monthly_rh) >= 2:
        vals_rh = monthly_rh.values.tolist()
        last_rh = vals_rh[-1]; prev_rh = vals_rh[-2]
        pct_rh = ((last_rh - prev_rh) / prev_rh * 100) if prev_rh != 0 else 0.0
        dir_rh = 'up' if pct_rh > 1 else ('down' if pct_rh < -1 else 'flat')
        result['trends'].append({'column': 'repair_hours', 'period': 'MoM', 'direction': dir_rh,
                                  'pct_change': round(float(pct_rh), 2), 'segment': None})
    # Corrective WO trend MoM
    df_corrective['report_month'] = df_corrective['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')
    monthly_cm = df_corrective.groupby('report_month')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_index()
    if len(monthly_cm) >= 2:
        vals_cm = monthly_cm.values.tolist()
        last_cm = vals_cm[-1]; prev_cm = vals_cm[-2]
        pct_cm = ((last_cm - prev_cm) / prev_cm * 100) if prev_cm != 0 else 0.0
        dir_cm = 'up' if pct_cm > 1 else ('down' if pct_cm < -1 else 'flat')
        result['trends'].append({'column': 'WONUM', 'period': 'MoM', 'direction': dir_cm,
                                  'pct_change': round(float(pct_cm), 2), 'segment': 'corrective'})
except Exception:
    pass

# --- ANOMALIES ---
try:
    anomalies = []
    col = 'repair_hours'
    rh_col = df_active[col].dropna()
    rh_col = rh_col[rh_col >= 0]
    skew = float(rh_col.skew())
    if abs(skew) > 2:
        shift = max(0, -rh_col.min())
        transformed = np.log1p(rh_col + shift)
    else:
        transformed = rh_col.copy()
        shift = 0
    q1 = transformed.quantile(0.25)
    q3 = transformed.quantile(0.75)
    iqr = q3 - q1
    lo3 = q1 - 3 * iqr; hi3 = q3 + 3 * iqr
    lo4 = q1 - 4 * iqr; hi4 = q3 + 4 * iqr
    lo5 = q1 - 5 * iqr; hi5 = q3 + 5 * iqr
    extreme_mask = (transformed < lo3) | (transformed > hi3)
    extreme_frac = extreme_mask.sum() / len(transformed)
    if extreme_frac > 0.05:
        anomalies.append({'column': col, 'row_index': None, 'value': None,
                          'expected_range': f'{float(np.expm1(hi3) - shift):.2f} hrs upper (3xIQR)',
                          'severity': 'low', 'explanation': f'{col} is heavy-tailed; extreme-value rule would flag >{extreme_frac*100:.1f}% of rows, so individual anomalies are not reported'})
    else:
        extreme_idx = rh_col[extreme_mask].index
        if abs(skew) > 2:
            lo_orig = float(np.expm1(lo3) - shift)
            hi_orig = float(np.expm1(hi3) - shift)
        else:
            lo_orig = float(lo3); hi_orig = float(hi3)
        exp_range = f'[{lo_orig:.2f}, {hi_orig:.2f}] hrs'
        for idx in extreme_idx[:25]:
            val = float(rh_col.loc[idx])
            t_val = transformed.loc[idx]
            if t_val > hi5 or t_val < lo5:
                sev = 'critical'
            elif t_val > hi4 or t_val < lo4:
                sev = 'high'

df_active = df[~df['row_kind'].isin(cancel_kinds)].copy()

for col in ['REPORTDATE','ACTSTART','ACTFINISH']:
    df_active[col] = pd.to_datetime(df_active[col], utc=True, errors='coerce')

cm_types = ['cm','em','corrective','corrective maintenance','emergency','emergency maintenance',
            'emergency repair','breakdown','breakdown maintenance','breakdown repair',
            'reactive','reactive maintenance','unplanned','unplanned maintenance',
            'unplanned breakdown','repair','fault','failure']
pm_types = ['pm','preventive','preventive maintenance','planned','planned maintenance',
            'pdm','predictive','predictive maintenance','condition based','cbm',
            'inspection','routine','calibration']
open_statuses = ['inprg','in progress','wappr','waiting on approval','appr','approved',
                 'wmatl','waiting on material','wsched','waiting to be scheduled','open','hold']

wt_lower = df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().str.strip()

# --- EDA ---
try:
    s = df_active['repair_hours'].dropna()
    result['eda_summary']['repair_hours'] = {
        "mean": float(s.mean()), "std": float(s.std()),
        "min": float(s.min()), "max": float(s.max()),
        "median": float(s.median()), "count": int(s.count())
    }
except Exception:
    pass

# --- SEGMENTATION ---
try:
    segs = []

    # WO count by WORKTYPE
    for sc in ['WORKTYPE', 'STATUS', 'FAILURECODE']:
        grp = df_active.groupby(sc)['WONUM'].nunique().reset_index()
        grp.columns = [sc, 'val']
        grp = grp.nlargest(10, 'val')
        segs.append({
            "segment_column": sc, "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "count",
            "label": "wo_count",
            "results": [{"name": str(r[sc]), "value": float(r['val'])} for _, r in grp.iterrows()]
        })

    # PM share
    total_wo = df_active['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_wo = df_active[wt_lower.isin(pm_types)]['WONUM'].nunique()
    cm_wo = df_active[wt_lower.isin(cm_types)]['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_share_val = float(pm_wo / total_wo) if total_wo > 0 else 0.0
    cm_share_val = float(cm_wo / total_wo) if total_wo > 0 else 0.0
    segs.append({
        "segment_column": "WORKTYPE", "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "ratio",
        "label": "pm_share",
        "results": [{"name": "pm", "value": pm_share_val},
                    {"name": "cm_em", "value": cm_share_val}]
    })

    # MTTR by FAILURECODE (CM/EM, repair_hours >= 0)
    cm_df = df_active[wt_lower.isin(cm_types) & (df_active['repair_hours'] >= 0)].copy()
    if len(cm_df) > 0:
        mttr_grp = cm_df.groupby('FAILURECODE').agg(
            total_h=('repair_hours', 'sum'),
            wo_count=('WONUM', 'nunique')
        ).reset_index()
        mttr_grp['mttr'] = mttr_grp['total_h'] / mttr_grp['wo_count']
        mttr_grp = mttr_grp.nlargest(10, 'mttr')
        segs.append({
            "segment_column": "FAILURECODE", "metric_column": "repair_hours",
            "aggregation": "ratio", "label": "mttr_hours",
            "results": [{"name": str(r['FAILURECODE']), "value": float(r['mttr'])}
                        for _, r in mttr_grp.iterrows()]
        })

    # repair_hours mean by WORKTYPE (non-null)
    rh_grp = df_active.groupby('WORKTYPE')['repair_hours'].mean().reset_index()
    rh_grp.columns = ['WORKTYPE', 'val']
    rh_grp = rh_grp.nlargest(10, 'val')
    segs.append({
        "segment_column": "WORKTYPE", "metric_column": "repair_hours",
        "aggregation": "mean", "label": "mean_repair_hours",
        "results": [{"name": str(r['WORKTYPE']), "value": float(r['val'])} for _, r in rh_grp.iterrows()]
    })

    # Open WOs by STATUS
    open_df = df_active[df_active['STATUS'].str.lower().str.strip().isin(open_statuses)]
    open_grp = open_df.groupby('STATUS')['WONUM'].nunique().reset_index()
    open_grp.columns = ['STATUS', 'val']
    segs.append({
        "segment_column": "STATUS", "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "count",
        "label": "open_wo_count",
        "results": [{"name": str(r['STATUS']), "value": float(r['val'])} for _, r in open_grp.iterrows()]
    })

    # WORKTYPE x STATUS cross-breakdown
    cross = df_active.groupby(['WORKTYPE', 'STATUS'])['WONUM'].nunique().reset_index()
    cross.columns = ['WORKTYPE', 'STATUS', 'val']
    cross = cross.nlargest(10, 'val')
    segs.append({
        "segment_column": "WORKTYPE|STATUS", "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "count",
        "label": None,
        "results": [{"name": f"{r['WORKTYPE']}|{r['STATUS']}", "value": float(r['val'])}
                    for _, r in cross.iterrows()]
    })

    result['segments'] = segs
except Exception:
    pass

# --- TRENDS ---
try:
    trends = []
    df_active['_ym'] = df_active['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')

    # MoM WO count
    monthly_wo = df_active.groupby('_ym')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_index()
    if len(monthly_wo) >= 2:
        prev, last = float(monthly_wo.iloc[-2]), float(monthly_wo.iloc[-1])
        pct = float((last - prev) / prev * 100) if prev != 0 else 0.0
        direction = "up" if pct > 1 else ("down" if pct < -1 else "flat")
        trends.append({"column": "WONUM", "period": "MoM", "direction": direction,
                       "pct_change": round(pct, 2), "segment": None})

    # MoM repair_hours sum (CM/EM only)
    cm_rh = df_active[wt_lower.isin(cm_types) & (df_active['repair_hours'] >= 0)].copy()
    if len(cm_rh) > 0:
        cm_rh['_ym2'] = cm_rh['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')
        mo_rh = cm_rh.groupby('_ym2')['repair_hours'].sum().sort_index()
        if len(mo_rh) >= 2:
            p2, l2 = float(mo_rh.iloc[-2]), float(mo_rh.iloc[-1])
            pct2 = float((l2 - p2) / p2 * 100) if p2 != 0 else 0.0
            d2 = "up" if pct2 > 1 else ("down" if pct2 < -1 else "flat")
            trends.append({"column": "repair_hours", "period": "MoM", "direction": d2,
                           "pct_change": round(pct2, 2), "segment": "cm_em_only"})

    result['trends'] = trends
except Exception:
    pass

# --- ANOMALIES ---
try:
    anomalies = []
    s = df_active['repair_hours'].dropna()
    s = s[s >= 0]
    if len(s) >= 5:
        skew = float(s.skew())
        shift = 0.0
        use = np.log1p(s + shift) if abs(skew) > 2 else s
        q1, q3 = float(use.quantile(0.25)), float(use.quantile(0.75))
        iqr = q3 - q1
        lo3, hi3 = q1 - 3 * iqr, q3 + 3 * iqr
        lo4, hi4 = q1 - 4 * iqr, q3 + 4 * iqr
        lo5, hi5 = q1 - 5 * iqr, q3 + 5 * iqr
        extreme = use[(use < lo3) | (use > hi3)]
        if len(extreme) / len(use) > 0.05:
            anomalies.append({
                "column": "repair_hours", "row_index": None, "value": None,
                "expected_range": "heavy-tailed distribution", "severity": "low",
                "explanation": "repair_hours is heavy-tailed; extreme values are natural, not flagged individually"
            })
        else:
            if abs(skew) > 2:
                orig_lo = float(np.expm1(lo3) - shift)
                orig_hi = float(np.expm1(hi3) - shift)
            else:
                orig_lo, orig_hi = float(lo3), float(hi3)
            exp_range = f"{orig_lo:.2f} to {orig_hi:.2f} hours"
            count = 0
            for idx in extreme.index:
                if count >= 25:
                    break
                orig_val = float(s.loc[idx]) if idx in s.index else None
                if orig_val is None:
                    continue
                u_val = float(use.loc[idx])
                if u_val < lo5 or u_val > hi5:
                    sev = "critical"
                elif u_val < lo4 or u_val > hi4:
                    sev = "high"
                else:
                    sev = "medium"
                anomalies.append({
                    "column": "repair_hours", "row_index": int(idx),
                    "value": round(orig_val, 3),
                    "expected_range": exp_range, "severity": sev,
                    "explanation": f"repair_hours value {round(orig_val,3)} lies outside expected range {exp_range}"
                })
                count += 1
    result['anomalies'] = anomalies
except Exception:
    pass

result['assumptions'] = [
    "Cancelled/test rows (row_kind cancel/void/rejected/test) excluded from all KPIs.",

    "Anomaly IQR uses 3×IQR extreme boundary; log1p applied when |skew| > 2.",
    "Only repair_hours used for numeric EDA/anomaly; date-derived columns not re-computed."
]

import pandas as pd

# Parse dates
for col in ['REPORTDATE', 'ACTSTART', 'ACTFINISH']:
    df_active[col] = pd.to_datetime(df_active[col], utc=True, errors='coerce')

# Use repair_hours from data directly
repair_col = 'repair_hours' if 'repair_hours' in df_active.columns else None

# --- EDA ---
try:
    eda = {}
    if repair_col and df_active[repair_col].notna().sum() > 0:
        s = df_active[repair_col].dropna()
        eda[repair_col] = {
            "mean": float(s.mean()), "std": float(s.std()), "min": float(s.min()),
            "max": float(s.max()), "median": float(s.median()), "count": int(s.count())
        }
    # Derived numeric: response_hours (report to actstart), duration_hours (actstart to actfinish)
    df_active['_response_h'] = (df_active['ACTSTART'] - df_active['REPORTDATE']).dt.total_seconds() / 3600
    df_active['_duration_h'] = (df_active['ACTFINISH'] - df_active['ACTSTART']).dt.total_seconds() / 3600
    for col, label in [('_response_h', 'response_hours'), ('_duration_h', 'duration_hours')]:
        s = df_active[col].dropna()
        s = s[s >= 0]
        if len(s) > 0:
            eda[label] = {
                "mean": float(s.mean()), "std": float(s.std()), "min": float(s.min()),
                "max": float(s.max()), "median": float(s.median()), "count": int(s.count())
            }
    result['eda_summary'] = eda
except Exception:
    pass

# --- SEGMENTATION ---
try:
    segs = []
    seg_cols = ['WORKTYPE', 'STATUS', 'FAILURECODE']

    # WO counts per segment
    for sc in seg_cols:
        grp = df_active.groupby(sc)['WONUM'].nunique().reset_index()
        grp.columns = [sc, 'val']
        grp = grp.nlargest(10, 'val')
        segs.append({
            "segment_column": sc, "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "count",
            "label": "wo_count",
            "results": [{"name": str(r[sc]), "value": float(r['val'])} for _, r in grp.iterrows()]
        })

    # PM share overall
    cm_types = ['cm','em','corrective','corrective maintenance','emergency','emergency maintenance',
                'emergency repair','breakdown','breakdown maintenance','breakdown repair',
                'reactive','reactive maintenance','unplanned','unplanned maintenance',
                'unplanned breakdown','repair','fault','failure']
    pm_types = ['pm','preventive','preventive maintenance','planned','planned maintenance',
                'pdm','predictive','predictive maintenance','condition based','cbm',
                'inspection','routine','calibration']
    wt_lower = df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().str.strip()
    total_wo = df_active['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_wo = df_active[wt_lower.isin(pm_types)]['WONUM'].nunique()
    cm_wo = df_active[wt_lower.isin(cm_types)]['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_share_val = pm_wo / total_wo if total_wo > 0 else 0.0
    segs.append({
        "segment_column": "WORKTYPE", "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "ratio",
        "label": "pm_share",
        "results": [{"name": "pm", "value": float(pm_share_val)},
                    {"name": "cm_em", "value": float(cm_wo / total_wo if total_wo > 0 else 0)}]
    })

    # MTTR by FAILURECODE (CM/EM only, repair_hours >= 0)
    if repair_col:
        cm_df = df_active[wt_lower.isin(cm_types) & (df_active[repair_col] >= 0)].copy()
        if len(cm_df) > 0:
            mttr_grp = cm_df.groupby('FAILURECODE').agg(
                total_h=(repair_col, 'sum'), wo_count=('WONUM', 'nunique')
            ).reset_index()
            mttr_grp['mttr'] = mttr_grp['total_h'] / mttr_grp['wo_count']
            mttr_grp = mttr_grp.nlargest(10, 'mttr')
            segs.append({
                "segment_column": "FAILURECODE", "metric_column": repair_col,
                "aggregation": "ratio", "label": "mttr_hours",
                "results": [{"name": str(r['FAILURECODE']), "value": float(r['mttr'])}
                            for _, r in mttr_grp.iterrows()]
            })

    # Open WOs by STATUS
    open_statuses = ['inprg','in progress','wappr','waiting on approval','appr','approved',
                     'wmatl','waiting on material','wsched','waiting to be scheduled','open','hold']
    open_df = df_active[df_active['STATUS'].str.lower().str.strip().isin(open_statuses)]
    open_grp = open_df.groupby('STATUS')['WONUM'].nunique().reset_index()
    open_grp.columns = ['STATUS', 'val']
    segs.append({
        "segment_column": "STATUS", "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "count",
        "label": "open_wo_count",
        "results": [{"name": str(r['STATUS']), "value": float(r['val'])} for _, r in open_grp.iterrows()]
    })

    # WORKTYPE x STATUS breakdown
    cross = df_active.groupby(['WORKTYPE', 'STATUS'])['WONUM'].nunique().reset_index()
    cross.columns = ['WORKTYPE', 'STATUS', 'val']
    cross = cross.nlargest(10, 'val')
    segs.append({
        "segment_column": "WORKTYPE|STATUS", "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "count",
        "label": None,
        "results": [{"name": f"{r['WORKTYPE']}|{r['STATUS']}", "value": float(r['val'])}
                    for _, r in cross.iterrows()]
    })

    result['segments'] = segs
except Exception:
    pass

# --- TRENDS ---
try:
    trends = []
    df_active['_ym'] = df_active['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')
    monthly_wo = df_active.groupby('_ym')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_index()
    if len(monthly_wo) >= 2:
        pct = float((monthly_wo.iloc[-1] - monthly_wo.iloc[-2]) / monthly_wo.iloc[-2] * 100) if monthly_wo.iloc[-2] != 0 else 0.0
        direction = "up" if pct > 1 else ("down" if pct < -1 else "flat")
        trends.append({"column": "WONUM", "period": "MoM", "direction": direction,
                       "pct_change": round(pct, 2), "segment": None})

    # MoM trend for repair_hours (CM only)
    if repair_col:
        cm_df2 = df_active[df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().str.strip().isin(cm_types) & (df_active[repair_col] >= 0)].copy()
        if len(cm_df2) > 0:
            cm_df2['_ym2'] = cm_df2['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')
            mo_rh = cm_df2.groupby('_ym2')[repair_col].sum().sort_index()
            if len(mo_rh) >= 2:
                pct2 = float((mo_rh.iloc[-1] - mo_rh.iloc[-2]) / mo_rh.iloc[-2] * 100) if mo_rh.iloc[-2] != 0 else 0.0
                d2 = "up" if pct2 > 1 else ("down" if pct2 < -1 else "flat")
                trends.append({"column": repair_col, "period": "MoM", "direction": d2,
                               "pct_change": round(pct2, 2), "segment": "cm_em_only"})

    result['trends'] = trends
except Exception:
    pass

# --- ANOMALIES ---
try:
    anomalies = []
    anom_cols = []
    if repair_col and df_active[repair_col].notna().sum() >= 5:
        anom_cols.append(repair_col)
    for c in ['_response_h', '_duration_h']:
        s = df_active[c].dropna()
        s = s[s >= 0]
        if len(s) >= 5:
            anom_cols.append(c)

    total_emitted = 0
    for col in anom_cols:
        if total_emitted >= 25:
            break
        raw = df_active[col].dropna() if col == repair_col else df_active[col].dropna()
        if col in ['_response_h', '_duration_h']:
            raw = raw[raw >= 0]
        if len(raw) < 5:
            continue
        skew = float(raw.skew())
        shift = 0.0
        if raw.min() < 0:
            shift = -raw.min()
        use = np.log1p(raw + shift) if abs(skew) > 2 else raw
        q1, q3 = float(use.quantile(0.25)), float(use.quantile(0.75))
        iqr = q3 - q1
        lo3, hi3 = q1 - 3 * iqr, q3 + 3 * iqr
        lo4, hi4 = q1 - 4 * iqr, q3 + 4 * iqr
        lo5, hi5 = q1 - 5 * iqr, q3 + 5 * iqr
        extreme = use[(use < lo3) | (use > hi3)]
        if len(extreme) / len(use) > 0.05:
            anomalies.append({"column": col, "row_index": None, "value": None,
                              "expected_range": "heavy-tailed distribution",
                              "severity": "low",
                              "explanation": f"{col} is heavy-tailed; extreme values are natural, not flagged individually"})
            continue
        # Convert back to original units for expected_range
        if abs(skew) > 2:
            orig_lo = float(np.expm1(lo3) - shift)
            orig_hi = float(np.expm1(hi3) - shift)
        else:
            orig_lo, orig_hi = float(lo3), float(hi3)
        exp_range = f"{orig_lo:.2f} to {orig_hi:.2f} hours"
        for idx in extreme.index:
            if total_emitted >= 25:
                break
            orig_val = float(raw.loc[idx]) if idx in raw.index else None
            if orig_val is None:
                continue
            u_val = float(use.loc[idx])
            if u_val < lo5 or u_val > hi5:
                sev = "critical"
            elif u_val < lo4 or u_val > hi4:
                sev = "high"
            else:
                sev = "medium"
            anomalies.append({"column": col, "row_index": int(idx),
                              "value": round(orig_val, 3),
                              "expected_range": exp_range, "severity": sev,
                              "explanation": f"{col} value {round(orig_val,3)} lies outside expected range {exp_range}"})
            total_emitted += 1

    result['anomalies'] = anomalies
except Exception:
    pass

# --- ASSUMPTIONS ---
result['assumptions'] = [
    "Cancelled work orders (row_kind cancel/void/rejected) excluded from all KPIs.",
    "MTTR computed only for CM/EM work types with repair_hours >= 0.",

    "response_hours and duration_hours derived from REPORTDATE→ACTSTART and ACTSTART→ACTFINISH; negative values excluded.",
    "Anomaly IQR uses 3×IQR extreme boundary; log1p applied when |skew|>2."
]

            'reactive','reactive maintenance','unplanned','unplanned maintenance',
            'unplanned breakdown','repair','fault','failure']
pm_types = ['pm','preventive','preventive maintenance','planned','planned maintenance',
            'pdm','predictive','predictive maintenance','condition based','cbm',
            'inspection','routine','calibration']
open_statuses = ['inprg','in progress','wappr','waiting on approval','appr','approved',
                 'wmatl','waiting on material','wsched','waiting to be scheduled','open','hold']

wt_lower = df_active['WORKTYPE'].str.lower().str.strip()

# --- EDA ---
try:
    s = df_active['repair_hours'].dropna()
    result['eda_summary']['repair_hours'] = {
        "mean": float(s.mean()), "std": float(s.std()),
        "min": float(s.min()), "max": float(s.max()),
        "median": float(s.median()), "count": int(s.count())
    }
except Exception:
    pass

# --- SEGMENTATION ---
try:
    segs = []

    # WO count by WORKTYPE
    for sc in ['WORKTYPE', 'STATUS', 'FAILURECODE']:
        grp = df_active.groupby(sc)['WONUM'].nunique().reset_index()
        grp.columns = [sc, 'val']
        grp = grp.nlargest(10, 'val')
        segs.append({
            "segment_column": sc, "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "count",
            "label": "wo_count",
            "results": [{"name": str(r[sc]), "value": float(r['val'])} for _, r in grp.iterrows()]
        })

    # PM share
    total_wo = df_active['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_wo = df_active[wt_lower.isin(pm_types)]['WONUM'].nunique()
    cm_wo = df_active[wt_lower.isin(cm_types)]['WONUM'].nunique()
    pm_share_val = float(pm_wo / total_wo) if total_wo > 0 else 0.0
    cm_share_val = float(cm_wo / total_wo) if total_wo > 0 else 0.0
    segs.append({
        "segment_column": "WORKTYPE", "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "ratio",
        "label": "pm_share",
        "results": [{"name": "pm", "value": pm_share_val},
                    {"name": "cm_em", "value": cm_share_val}]
    })

    # MTTR by FAILURECODE (CM/EM, repair_hours >= 0)
    cm_df = df_active[wt_lower.isin(cm_types) & (df_active['repair_hours'] >= 0)].copy()
    if len(cm_df) > 0:
        mttr_grp = cm_df.groupby('FAILURECODE').agg(
            total_h=('repair_hours', 'sum'),
            wo_count=('WONUM', 'nunique')
        ).reset_index()
        mttr_grp['mttr'] = mttr_grp['total_h'] / mttr_grp['wo_count']
        mttr_grp = mttr_grp.nlargest(10, 'mttr')
        segs.append({
            "segment_column": "FAILURECODE", "metric_column": "repair_hours",
            "aggregation": "ratio", "label": "mttr_hours",
            "results": [{"name": str(r['FAILURECODE']), "value": float(r['mttr'])}
                        for _, r in mttr_grp.iterrows()]
        })

    # repair_hours mean by WORKTYPE (non-null)
    rh_grp = df_active.groupby('WORKTYPE')['repair_hours'].mean().reset_index()
    rh_grp.columns = ['WORKTYPE', 'val']
    rh_grp = rh_grp.nlargest(10, 'val')
    segs.append({
        "segment_column": "WORKTYPE", "metric_column": "repair_hours",
        "aggregation": "mean", "label": "mean_repair_hours",
        "results": [{"name": str(r['WORKTYPE']), "value": float(r['val'])} for _, r in rh_grp.iterrows()]
    })

    # Open WOs by STATUS
    open_df = df_active[df_active['STATUS'].str.lower().str.strip().isin(open_statuses)]
    open_grp = open_df.groupby('STATUS')['WONUM'].nunique().reset_index()
    open_grp.columns = ['STATUS', 'val']
    segs.append({
        "segment_column": "STATUS", "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "count",
        "label": "open_wo_count",
        "results": [{"name": str(r['STATUS']), "value": float(r['val'])} for _, r in open_grp.iterrows()]
    })

    # WORKTYPE x STATUS cross-breakdown
    cross = df_active.groupby(['WORKTYPE', 'STATUS'])['WONUM'].nunique().reset_index()
    cross.columns = ['WORKTYPE', 'STATUS', 'val']
    cross = cross.nlargest(10, 'val')
    segs.append({
        "segment_column": "WORKTYPE|STATUS", "metric_column": "WONUM", "aggregation": "count",
        "label": None,
        "results": [{"name": f"{r['WORKTYPE']}|{r['STATUS']}", "value": float(r['val'])}
                    for _, r in cross.iterrows()]
    })

    result['segments'] = segs
except Exception:
    pass

# --- TRENDS ---
try:
    trends = []
    df_active['_ym'] = df_active['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')

    # MoM WO count
    monthly_wo = df_active.groupby('_ym')['WONUM'].nunique().sort_index()
    if len(monthly_wo) >= 2:
        prev, last = float(monthly_wo.iloc[-2]), float(monthly_wo.iloc[-1])
        pct = float((last - prev) / prev * 100) if prev != 0 else 0.0
        direction = "up" if pct > 1 else ("down" if pct < -1 else "flat")
        trends.append({"column": "WONUM", "period": "MoM", "direction": direction,
                       "pct_change": round(pct, 2), "segment": None})

    # MoM repair_hours sum (CM/EM only)
    cm_rh = df_active[wt_lower.isin(cm_types) & (df_active['repair_hours'] >= 0)].copy()
    if len(cm_rh) > 0:
        cm_rh['_ym2'] = cm_rh['REPORTDATE'].dt.to_period('M')
        mo_rh = cm_rh.groupby('_ym2')['repair_hours'].sum().sort_index()
        if len(mo_rh) >= 2:
            p2, l2 = float(mo_rh.iloc[-2]), float(mo_rh.iloc[-1])
            pct2 = float((l2 - p2) / p2 * 100) if p2 != 0 else 0.0
            d2 = "up" if pct2 > 1 else ("down" if pct2 < -1 else "flat")
            trends.append({"column": "repair_hours", "period": "MoM", "direction": d2,
                           "pct_change": round(pct2, 2), "segment": "cm_em_only"})

    result['trends'] = trends
except Exception:
    pass

# --- ANOMALIES ---
try:
    anomalies = []
    s = df_active['repair_hours'].dropna()
    s = s[s >= 0]
    if len(s) >= 5:
        skew = float(s.skew())
        shift = 0.0
        use = np.log1p(s + shift) if abs(skew) > 2 else s
        q1, q3 = float(use.quantile(0.25)), float(use.quantile(0.75))
        iqr = q3 - q1
        lo3, hi3 = q1 - 3 * iqr, q3 + 3 * iqr
        lo4, hi4 = q1 - 4 * iqr, q3 + 4 * iqr
        lo5, hi5 = q1 - 5 * iqr, q3 + 5 * iqr
        extreme = use[(use < lo3) | (use > hi3)]
        if len(extreme) / len(use) > 0.05:
            anomalies.append({
                "column": "repair_hours", "row_index": None, "value": None,
                "expected_range": "heavy-tailed distribution", "severity": "low",
                "explanation": "repair_hours is heavy-tailed; extreme values are natural, not flagged individually"
            })
        else:
            if abs(skew) > 2:
                orig_lo = float(np.expm1(lo3) - shift)
                orig_hi = float(np.expm1(hi3) - shift)
            else:
                orig_lo, orig_hi = float(lo3), float(hi3)
            exp_range = f"{orig_lo:.2f} to {orig_hi:.2f} hours"
            count = 0
            for idx in extreme.index:
                if count >= 25:
                    break
                orig_val = float(s.loc[idx]) if idx in s.index else None
                if orig_val is None:
                    continue
                u_val = float(use.loc[idx])
                if u_val < lo5 or u_val > hi5:
                    sev = "critical"
                elif u_val < lo4 or u_val > hi4:
                    sev = "high"
                else:
                    sev = "medium"
                anomalies.append({
                    "column": "repair_hours", "row_index": int(idx),
                    "value": round(orig_val, 3),
                    "expected_range": exp_range, "severity": sev,
                    "explanation": f"repair_hours value {round(orig_val,3)} lies outside expected range {exp_range}"
                })
                count += 1
    result['anomalies'] = anomalies
except Exception:
    pass

result['assumptions'] = [
    "Cancelled/test rows (row_kind cancel/void/rejected/test) excluded from all KPIs.",
    "MTTR uses repair_hours (pre-computed) for CM/EM work types with repair_hours >= 0.",
    "PM share = distinct PM WOs / all distinct non-cancelled WOs.",
    "Anomaly IQR uses 3×IQR extreme boundary; log1p applied when |skew| > 2.",
    "Only repair_hours used for numeric EDA/anomaly; date-derived columns not re-computed."
]
